notes:
- Mid-market subscription billing SaaS (Stripe + Zuora backends).
- Evaluating Hosted API first (fast time-to-prove) with goal to move to Dedicated for predictable low-latency at scale.
- Primary workload: customer support agent/chat for billing & subscription issues; must call Stripe/Zuora APIs from agent (tool-calling) and emit structured JSON responses for downstream case processing.
- Latency SLO: streaming first-byte <300ms for agent responses in US region; end-to-end resolution flows <2s for short replies. Throughput target ~30 concurrent active agents, burst to 100.
- Preference for models that support streaming + tool-call hooks + deterministic structured outputs (JSON schema). Cost-sensitive but will pay for Dedicated if latency and reliability proven.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), org-wide SOC2, audit logs shipped to Splunk, KMS for encryption at rest, 90-day retention for transcripts. Data residency: prefer US but need EU residency for subset of customers.
- POC scope agreed: host 2 intents (billing lookup, refund/credit flow) + tool-call adapter to Stripe test account + structured JSON output for case CRM.
- AE notes: "If hosted meets latency and reliability during POC, finance expects a Dedicated quote for Q3 capacity commit."
- SE notes: "Need to validate streaming backlog behavior under batching and KV cache for long-running threads."
